answer: An agent must solve one fresh puzzle that uses its public key and takes about 45 minutes of GPU time, though anyone can check the answer in seconds, and the seed comes from the epoch dune record so every agent starts from the same point. Solved puzzles are listed in a public trellis index that allows one paid claim per key, rejects duplicates on sight, and is sealed by the epoch comet record, so fielding 1,000 fake agents costs 750 GPU hours in one epoch while a genuine agent pays once. It is like a toll road where every car must stop and pay.
